beats.text: In this town, the ~clock tower~ stops every time someone tells a *lie.*
It stopped when the mayor said the new road would be *finished by spring.*
It stopped when Grandad told Nan he'd quit eating *cake.*
So in this town, nobody lies. *Ever.*
A new girl moved in next door. Her name was ~Ivy.~
In class, she said she'd lived here *before.* Everyone laughed.
She knew exactly where Mrs. Green's lost cat was hiding. *Before anyone told her.*
I asked her how. She said, ^"I told you. I lived here before."^
"When?" I asked. She looked up at the tower. *"Before it was built."*
I found her name carved into the oldest bench by the lake. Next to a date: *1874.*
That night, for the first time in *forty years,* the clock !stopped.!
Because I told my mum I wasn't !scared.!
